title: Emergency Neurology Care
hero_desc: When a neurological emergency strikes, every second counts. Under the guidance of Dr. Praveen Gupta, our team provides rapid, life-saving care for stroke, seizures, and head trauma.
section1_title: Expert Clinical Approach to Emergency Neurology Care
section1_text:
Dr. Praveen Gupta provides world-class diagnostic evaluation and cutting-edge treatments for Emergency Neurology Care.

With over 20 years of experience and more than 300,000 satisfied patients, our multidisciplinary team ensures the highest standard of neurological excellence.
